categories.main_business_segments: 361º operates primarily in the sportswear industry, focusing on two main brands: the 361º brand targeting the mass sports market with professional products in running, basketball, and sports life categories, and the 361º Kids brand, positioned as the 'Youth Sports Expert' catering to children and adolescents with sportswear and footwear. The company integrates branding, R&D, design, production, and distribution, and also engages in event sponsorship and proprietary sports events.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: 361º emphasizes technology-driven product development, utilizing advanced materials and proprietary technologies such as CQT Carbon Critical Technology, Q-bounce Super Technology, and FLYTEX waterproof membranes. The company operates a balanced production model with in-house manufacturing (approximately 30% of footwear and 19.5% of apparel) complemented by outsourcing to OEMs. It holds 633 patents and maintains a national advanced technology enterprise status, focusing on innovation in sports footwear, apparel, and accessories.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are sports enthusiasts and active consumers in China, including adults and children, with products tailored for running, basketball, outdoor activities, and fitness. The company also targets youth sports markets through 361º Kids. Its products serve mass market consumers seeking professional sportswear with good value, as well as niche segments like children’s sportswear and outdoor sports enthusiasts.
categories.geographic_coverage: 361º has a strong presence across all major cities and regions in Mainland China, with 5,750 stores for the core brand and 2,548 points-of-sale for 361º Kids. It is expanding internationally with 1,365 overseas points-of-sale covering the Americas, Europe, Southeast Asia, and Belt and Road Initiative regions. The company has launched an international e-commerce platform and opened its first directly operated overseas store in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
categories.supply_chain_position: 361º operates a vertically integrated supply chain covering branding, R&D, design, production, and distribution. It manufactures a significant portion of its products in-house while outsourcing the remainder to OEMs. The company manages a distributorship model for sales, partnering with exclusive distributors who operate retail stores or supply authorized retailers, positioning it midstream with control over product development and brand management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on technology-driven innovation, brand-first development, and expanding professional sports categories such as running and basketball. R&D investments target advanced materials, functional sports equipment, and product upgrades, including carbon-plated running shoes and professional basketball footwear. The company also emphasizes sustainable development, green manufacturing, and expanding into emerging sports segments like outdoor and children’s sportswear.
categories.revenue_model: 361º generates revenue primarily through product sales of footwear, apparel, and accessories via offline retail stores, authorized distributors, and e-commerce platforms. The company also benefits from event sponsorships and proprietary sports events that enhance brand visibility and drive sales. E-commerce accounts for about 25.9% of total revenue, with a focus on online-exclusive products and omnichannel integration.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: 361º is positioned as a leading domestic sportswear brand in China with a professional, youthful, and internationalized image. It competes with both domestic and international sportswear companies by offering high-quality, technology-driven products at competitive prices. The company leverages strategic partnerships with international sports events and athletes to strengthen its market position and brand recognition globally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, 361º reported revenue of RMB10.07 billion, a 19.6% year-on-year increase, with profit attributable to equity shareholders rising 19.5% to RMB1.15 billion. The company operates 5,750 core brand stores and 2,548 Kids points-of-sale in China, plus 1,365 international points-of-sale. E-commerce revenue grew 12.2% to RMB2.61 billion, accounting for 25.9% of total revenue. The company maintains a strong balance sheet with RMB4.25 billion in cash and a low gearing ratio of 1.9%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: 361º emphasizes professional sports functionality combined with youthful and trendy design, offering high-value products with advanced technology such as carbon-plated running shoes and specialized basketball footwear. The brand differentiates itself through deep integration with sports culture, event sponsorships, and a strong presence in children’s sportswear as a 'Youth Sports Expert.' Its commitment to innovation, sustainability, and international expansion further enhances its competitive edge.
